entities.name: Jean-Pierre Tanoh Tiémélé
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jean-Pierre Tanoh Tiémélé is an Ivorian Catholic prelate who was appointed Bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Abengourou, in Ivory Coast on 22 October 2025. Before that, from 29 January 2011 until 22 October 2025, he was a priest. He was appointed bishop of Agboville, by Pope Leo XIV. He was consecrated and installed at Agboville, Diocese of Agboville on 3 January 2026 by the Papal Nuncio to the Ivory Coast.

Before that, from 29 January 2011 until 22 October 2025, he was a priest. He was appointed bishop of Agboville, by Pope Leo XIV. He was consecrated and installed at Agboville, Diocese of Agboville on 3 January 2026 by the Papal Nuncio to the Ivory Coast.
